summary: This tutorial covers how to use various view options in LibreOffice Impress, a presentation software. It starts with the default Normal View, where you can see and edit slides. Other views include Slide Sorter for organizing slides in a specific order and Outline View for seeing the structure of your presentation as a hierarchical list. You can change slide designs using the Master Page section, which allows you to modify the overall look of your presentation. Notes View lets you write notes that will appear on your screen but not for the audience. The tutorial also explains how to rearrange slides by dragging them to new positions. Additionally, it demonstrates changing the layout of slides and adjusting the presentation layout through the Task Pane. The key takeaway is understanding how to effectively use these features to create and customize presentations in LibreOffice Impress.
